findings.desc: The plan can exfiltrate credentials or other secret values to external proposal hosts. Section 7 requires preserving exact identifiers (line 137), and section 8 sends Story fields plus the full deterministic seed list/provenance to Codex/Claude/agy (lines 149-156), while the only secret control applies to search snippets (line 391), after proposal input is already constructed. A Story description, backticked token, config value, error payload, related-doc title, or deterministic sourceRef containing a secret can therefore enter host prompts and proposal artifacts. Before implementation, define one pre-egress sanitization boundary over every host-bound field and artifact: transmit names/keys but never detected values, hash or omit sensitive provenance, reject/record unsafe proposals, and fall back to deterministic local routing when classification is uncertain. Add fixtures proving secrets in Story/checklist/seeds/path-title metadata never reach any host prompt or persisted proposal. Source: docs/requirements/decisions/multi-host-keyword-candidate-spec-routing-execution-plan.md:137,149-156,391.
